title: IntelX fact-check sampling — measured accuracy of stored research claims
auditor: muse_ai (Muse finisher crew; verification evidence gathered by six parallel checker crews)
methodology: Frozen in ~/workspace/int-005/METHODOLOGY.md before sampling (seed 20251115). Population per the 2026-11-15 amendment: all findings stored in IntelX production live_research_runs (the claims/evidence/sources tables are empty in production — 0 rows). 39 findings <= 40, so a full census was verified, not a sample.
method_caveat: browser.open (live fetch) failed fleet-wide for five of six checker crews (browser-service exit code 1 — a tool failure, not source failure). For those batches, quote alignment was assessed against browser.search indexed full-text copies of the cited pages themselves (quotes for B2/B3 were confirmed verbatim in the cited URLs' own indexed text; WHO quotes via the identical IARC/WHO joint release text). Batch F (run 9) and the population extraction used live fetches. 'Not found' for E1/E3 means absent from search snippets, not proven absent from the live page; both are therefore PARTIAL, not UNSUPPORTED. The Northwell page (run 6) is absent from the search index and was unfetchable, so its two excerpt claims are honestly UNVERIFIABLE.

population.provenance: 8 of 10 runs are AI-crew test/measurement probes (2x REL-038 probes, 6x INT-003 'before' depth-measurement runs, all 2026-11-14/15); 2 are task-driven runs (task_1408370e0a65, task_c168bd737fcd). No organic end-user research corpus exists in the store yet. 2 runs are DEGRADED/unsynthesised raw-excerpt dumps (runs 6 and 7, 18 of 39 findings, including all 4 NON_CLAIMs).

accuracy.note: Zero CONTRADICTED satisfied; the VERIFIED-share leg fails (65.7% < 90%). No fabricated facts were found anywhere: every PARTIAL is a citation-hygiene or corroboration defect, not a false statement.

defect_patterns: Citation hygiene, not fabrication: no stored statement's factual core was found false. Zero UNSUPPORTED, zero CONTRADICTED.

Quote fidelity gaps (3): one stored quote inserts a word its source sentence does not contain (R0F3); one stored quote could not be located on its cited page at all (R2F2 — the underlying fact was exactly right in the primary paper); two CrowdStrike quotes could not be confirmed verbatim via the search fallback (R8F1, R8F3 — live-fetch re-check may upgrade). Run r0/r2/r4 stored quotes_verified=true from the pipeline despite the R0F3 alteration, so the pipeline's own quote check is not reliable as-is.

Statement/citation mismatch (2): a statement bundling details its cited page does not contain (R4F2); a statement asserting flatly what its cited source attributes to a third party and explicitly hedges (R9F1).

Framing tension inside one topic: R2F1 ('entering real-world production in 2026') vs R4F3 ('has yet to reach scalability and commercialization') — both defensible under pilot-vs-scaled readings, but a reader of either run alone gets opposite impressions.
Degraded-mode boilerplate: all 4 NON_CLAIMs (page titles, breadcrumb, 'Skip to main content') come from the DEGRADED unsynthesised run r6 — the raw-excerpt fallback stores page chrome as findings.
Stale-by-replication: one Healthline excerpt (R6F9) repeats a chemotherapy-benefit suggestion that 2025 systematic reviews no longer support — true-to-source, but the source is dated.
Opinion excerpts stored as findings: 2 of run r7's 6 excerpts (R7F1, R7F3) are the cited author's expert judgement; they are genuine and aligned but cannot be 'verified' the way facts can.

remediation_required_by_methodology.trigger: Accuracy below the pre-declared standard (65.7% VERIFIED < 90%) obliges a verification pass in the research pipeline.
remediation_required_by_methodology.status_in_this_delivery: Specified here and board-tracked as the TASK-INT-005 next action; NOT implemented in this PR (this crew's mandate was the audit itself; the pass is a pipeline code change for a follow-up crew under coordinator review).
pass_specification: Verbatim quote gate: before a finding is stored with quotes_verified=true, require the stored quote to appear verbatim (normalising only quote-mark style/whitespace) in the retrieved text of the cited URL; on failure, store the finding with quotes_verified=false and the mismatch flagged (would have caught R0F3).

Entailment/coverage check: every load-bearing detail in a synthesised statement (numbers, dates, named claims) must appear in at least one cited source's retrieved text; details failing coverage are dropped or the statement is marked partial (would have caught R4F2, R9F1's dropped hedging — attribution/hedging words in the source must survive synthesis).

Boilerplate filter: in DEGRADED raw-excerpt mode, drop excerpts that are page titles, breadcrumbs, or navigation strings (exact-title match against the page <title>/H1, 'Skip to main content' and similar chrome patterns) before storage (would have removed all 4 NON_CLAIMs).

Corroboration flag: findings stored from a single source carry independently_verified=false visibly in the run payload (currently every stored finding already has independently_verified=false/null — surface it in briefs instead of leaving it implicit).
Re-audit hook: after the pass ships, re-run this census method on newly stored runs; the standard remains >=90% VERIFIED, zero CONTRADICTED.
